_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: BI-A08EBAEC: analyze_mcp_call_efficiency turns the ToolExecution ledger into thrash/retry/volume findings so operators can cut agent token waste (skills, webhooks, tool merges) without a second telemetry store.

registry.packFiles.reason: Keeps supply coverage in its own bounded pack rather than widening the storefront pack, so the capability travels with its own grant (stock_read) and an archetype that stocks nothing never pays for it in its selection space.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Adds the governed live-delivery loop to Codex/Grok core discovery: quiescence status, self-upgrade queue status, request_self_upgrade, promoter-image repair, and runtime verification evidence. These tools are required immediately after a PR merges so an external coding agent can advance and prove the running install without opting into the full catalogue; authority remains bounded by capability, token scope, and grant gates.
